issue.title: Dependency stage opening 200/400/1000-task growth ratio flakes under full npm test load
issue.description: The unchanged bob-plugins 1caabb8 dependency-stage opening test fails under full npm test load: 1000-task build 469.8 ms versus 400-task 32.1 ms, exceeding the max(120, medium*6) growth assertion. A focused rerun on the same tree passes (79/79 across three files). Observed failure rate: 1/1 full-suite run versus 0/1 focused run. Source scripts/test-navigation-dependencies-stage-performance.cjs:64 takes one cold wall-clock sample for 200, 400, and 1000 tasks, so scheduler/JIT pauses alter the growth ratio. Fix the measurement while retaining candidate counts, absolute budgets, and a meaningful growth check; do not blindly raise the limit. Small scope: one known timing node. This is distinct from bob-cli-3w, which owns dependencyStageRank per-keystroke timing in stage-entry-and-view. All-status exact/synonym search, past-week sweep, and active-epic review found no duplicate or causal active epic. kr edits only album surfaces and acceptance.
